== Summary ==
GEMP import file for [[2022 MPC Barry Alperstein LS Communing]], rebuilt on 2026-11-04 by Holocron Claude from the decklist on that page. The original GEMP file from the event was not preserved. Each card's blueprintId comes from its wiki card page (GEMP id). Cards kept outside the deck (such as Defensive Shields) are not included.

archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-0/01/2022_MPC_Barry_Alperstein_LS_Communing_GEMP.txt Internet Archive item].
